tools.name: list_stages
tools.description: List the five stages and their supported photo modes. Hotel Lobby is only for two adult photos; use another stage for original characters.

tools.name: list_examples
tools.description: Show real published Raploom outputs and their actual lyrics. Use these to explain possibilities, not to promise an identical result. Optional use filter. Disclosures must stay visible.

tools.name: draft_lyrics
tools.description: Write four short English rap lyric lines for free. Treat them as a draft: show the words and let the user approve or edit before ordering. With two performers, lines 1–2 are A and lines 3–4 are B; a recipient is not another singer.

tools.name: create_character_video_order
tools.description: Create an UNPAID order for 1–2 original characters, without photos. ONLY call after the user explicitly approves the characters, four lyrics and delivery email. No charge, Stripe session or video generation happens here. One video $9.90; three $19.90, one-time purchase. Give payUrl exactly as return

tools.name: get_photo_video_link
tools.description: For a video from one person, two separate people, or a pet photo, give the user a website creation link. Photos, screening and consenting-adult declarations must be completed on raploom.com. Never accept photos through this tool.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Read a private order using BOTH its orderId and accessToken returned at creation. Never look up orders by email. Return only payment/video state and the private order link; video downloads stay on the website.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_character_video_order, get_order_status · Private data: get_order_status · Public sink: create_character_video_order, get_order_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_character_video_order, get_order_status · Private data: get_order_status · Public sink: create_character_video_order, get_order_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
